effects_provenance.raw: Creme Brulee THCA Flower Essential / 28g (Smalls) Strain Profile Creme Brulee THCA Flower is a dessert-rich indica-leaning hybrid that lives up to its decadent namesake. The cultivar produces dense, well-structured buds with a rich aromatic profile blending vanilla custard, caramelized sugar, and a light dusting of warm spice — bag appeal first with serious dessert-forward flavor character. Effects Creme Brulee delivers a comfortable, indica-leaning experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with deep body relaxation. The high lands steadily and lasts — suitable for late-afternoon use, evening unwinding, or settling in with flavor character intact. A reliable flavor-led cultivar. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: smooth vanilla custard up front, with caramelized sugar through the middle and a warm light-spice finish on the exhale. Smoke is silky and unmistakably dessert-rich. The terpene profile reads vanilla-and-caramel — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Creme Brulee harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Creme Brulee THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Creme Brulee THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. indica Spice Sugar Vanilla THCA Flower Lost In Translation
